title.narrative: Rubble Removal and Management in Rural Damascus Governorate

description.narrative: Removal of at least 75,000 m3 of rubble scattered across roads and public facilities in Daraya and Douma, Rural Damascus Governorate, with recycling of an estimated 30,000 m3 of the removed rubble into final products, contributing to reducing the environmental and health impacts of rubble and utilizing available resources for reconstruction.

Removing and recycling rubble in the cities of Daraya and Douma in Rural Damascus Governorate, among the areas most affected by the Syrian crisis, contributing to improving the general environment and facilitating the movement of residents, in addition to supporting the return of displaced persons to their areas.

Support recovery efforts in the affected areas of Daraya and Douma in Rural Damascus Governorate by removing rubble scattered across roads and public facilities, contributing to improving the environmental and health situation, facilitating residents' movement, and supporting the return of displaced persons. The project also aims to strengthen local capacities by providing equipment to support removal and recycling operations, contributing to the continuity of rubble removal and recycling operations to support reconstruction.
Disbursement for "Rubble Removal and Management in Rural Damascus Governorate" in Syria, implemented by Syrian Civil Defense (White Helmets)
